title: Darling in the Franxx: Sunset over Plantation 13
alt: A red plain at dusk under a blue-green sky with great rose and gold clouds. At the left, far off, stands a vast low dome of pale steel plates with a small dome of glass on its top. At the right a black wedge as high as a mountain comes up out of a cloud of dust. It has rock on its back, thin lines of blue light along its side and the sun behind it. In its shade a dark tide of small beasts with blue lights crosses the plain toward the dome. Long curved black horns stand up out of the tide. Thin lines of colored light go out from the dome to meet it. A red line goes up to the point of the wedge and ends in a white burst. Near us is a rise of dark rock with dry brush.
summary: A painting of the great klaxosaur at Plantation 13 from Darling in the Franxx in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the world of Darling in the Franxx, the anime by A-1 Pictures and Trigger. People live in moving cities, the Plantations, each under one dome of steel. The small dome of glass on the top is the Birdcage, where the children live who fight for the city.

The enemies are the klaxosaurs, which are black with lines of blue light. The great one here is of the largest kind, and the small ones are a tide of blue lights in its shade. The children fight them in machines that are called Franxx. Here each Franxx is only a line of light, and the red line is Strelizia. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
